subject: Quick peek at the revised questions
text:
Hi there,

Thanks for your note yesterday. I finally had a spare evening to tidy up the little survey we discussed, and I wanted to pass along the latest version before I send it around. I cut the opening questions down because they were getting a bit wordy, and I moved the part about opening times toward the end so people can answer it without overthinking. The main thing I still can’t settle is whether the last section sounds too much like a formal complaint form. I was aiming for helpful neighbour energy, but after three rewrites it may now be leaning more toward polite council questionnaire.

If you get a couple of minutes, could you skim the questions and tell me which ones feel awkward, too long, or oddly personal? I’m especially unsure whether asking for a suggested meeting day will make people bail out before finishing. I’ve left a short optional box for comments in case anyone wants to mention parking, lighting, or anything else they care about, but I don’t want it to turn into a wishlist marathon.

I also added a one-line intro explaining that the answers only cover the shared courtyard, not the whole block, because last time a few folks seemed to think I was asking about their flats. I’ll wait until after the weekend before sending it.

No rush at all. If you’re swamped, just say so. I’d rather get an honest gut reaction than a polished review.

Thanks again,
A patient neighbour
